proposition.claim:
Nonzero discriminant alone implies a finite uniform count of all |F(X,Y)|<=m.

The proof uses sum_{U<=|u|<2U}f(|u|)<<U for every separable cubic and obtains exponent max(lambda,2).

A nonzero O(x3) lattice vector is counted as an admissible point with x4!=0 and gcd(x1,x2,x4)=1.

Specified L/Q and K21(sqrt(alpha21))/Q are Galois and contain K(sqrt(B)).

m=O(logloglog N) suffices for the strict fixed-multiplier range m<Cprime logloglog N when k<=logloglog N and q=1/epsilon.

The moment is <=exp(C m^2) for every sufficiently small positive m.

-1/2+5/8=-1/8

The printed equation omits D^2,D^3 and uses old x.
